LA Animal Services and Best Friends ran an Adventure Buddy Day (last held Aug 23, 2025) letting the public take eligible dogs out for the day; pick up 9-11am, first come first served, or pre-register by emailing the foster form to ani.foster@lacity.org. No upcoming date was announced on the LAAS site as of November 2026.
